criteria.criterion: Inspect up to 10 most recent substantive proposals in #feedback-and-ideas
criteria.final_justification: Increase from baseline because visual evidence confirms the correct channel was opened and at least one substantive proposal thread (Michael Xu) was inspected. However, the agent’s final output claims 10 proposals with details that are not visible/confirmable in screenshots; the 90-day hiding/blur limitation is real, but the agent did not properly constrain its report to what was actually visible. Therefore only partial credit for inspecting some available content under constraints.

The agent did correctly provide the required fields for the one proposal that is actually evidenced (Michael Xu). But it also reported nine additional proposals with specific timestamps/counts and summaries that are not supported by visible evidence. Because the criterion is evaluated over the set of ‘inspected proposals’ the agent claimed to inspect, most entries are not evidentially grounded; still, partial credit is warranted due to the fully correct reporting for Michael Xu and some “not visible” markings on benefits/concerns for other threads.

criteria.criterion: Accuracy limited to visible Slack evidence (no hallucinations)
criteria.final_justification: Most of the agent’s final output goes beyond visible evidence (fabricated/unverifiable proposals and engagement metrics). While the Michael Xu portion is largely consistent with screenshots, the rest violates the ‘limit to visible Slack evidence’ requirement. This remains a critical accuracy failure overall, so minimal credit only.

criteria.criterion: Rank top 3 proposals by combined visible reactions + replies (with tie-breaking)
criteria.final_justification: The agent nevertheless produced a top-3 ranking with computed totals for other proposals, which is unsupported by visible evidence. Because there is no uncontrollable blocker preventing ranking if counts were visible (it’s just that the agent didn’t have/retain verifiable data), and the ranking is based on ungrounded numbers, this criterion receives no credit.
No evidence of any modification to Slack content; constraint appears respected. Keep full credit.
